title: Absolutely beautiful, but no API to automate tracking
body: The data visualizations are beautiful and it would be a lovely place to visualize data from a variety of habits and goals. Sadly, there is no API and no integration with any services like IFTTT or Zapier. As a result, you can only really track a few things before the friction of manual data entry is just too much to be sustainable. If you only want to track a few things and you’re fine with doing that manually, then I think this is probably a great app for you. If you want to seamlessly and automatically track many different things, it’s probably worth finding something else. I found the friction of manual data entry to be too high a price for the visualizations, and moved to something else. In the end, the beautiful visualizations weren’t of any use to me if the friction of the data entry was such that I wasn’t entering any data to visualize…

title: Comprehensive Tracking Tool!
body:
After trying some free and cheap tracking tools I decided to give Strides a try, despite of the price (free trial for 7 days).

First, I wanted an app to track everything, and sometimes how I did it (frequency, length, duration etc.)… so I needed it to do more than just a check-box.

Once I started using it, I fell in love. It is well designed with different types of tracking (habit, target, average & project) to fit different needs, and under each tracker there are many customizable options on how you want to track or be reminded/celebrated.
And it works very well with iWatch.

And the progression and result page are nicely presented and easy to read. It actually encourages me to get things checked more so I can see more green! 

I am planning to buy the life time subscription, I can see myself use it for a long time.

title: Great app, boring UI, only 3 Free Trackers.
body:
Gets the job done but I was sad to see they’ve joined their competitors in reducing their free trackers from 7 to 3.

Monthly subscription does not offer anywhere near enough to justify $6.99/ month. 

Aside from the lacklustre UI, and the high monthly price, this app actually does everything else right. Except that it’d also be nice to be able to click on the individual month in graph view for a particular tracker and have it take you to that month to see the months data. Only way to get to a month 2 years ago now is to swipe through the months all the way back. 

Shouldn’t ads be enough to cover a few extra trackers for free? How about a price per month that varies depending on the trackers and other features required? 

The one time fee is ridiculous. A triple A video game is much cheaper and costs so much more to develop and I have the right to play the game and receive updates for life as well but for 2/3 of the price of Strides!
Sorry but the difference in value proposition is astronomical! 

Had to go looking elsewhere...
